title: [review] router.rs:667: Sequence number leak on sign_d
description: In build_signed_dao, reserve_next() is called at line 667 to consume a sequence number. If sign_dao() fails at line 671-672, the function returns early with an error but the sequence number is already consumed and never finalized. While the 64-bit sequence space makes exhaustion unlikely, this creates gaps in the replay protection floor that could confuse debugging or have subtle replay window effects if the pattern repeats.
close_reason: Fixed: Moved unsigned DAO construction before reserve_next() and added can_sign_unsigned_dao() pre-validation. Now if DAO validation fails (malformed, already signed, DODAG ID mismatch), the error is returned before any sequence number is consumed. This prevents sequence gaps when sign_dao() would fail.
